_doc: Generators: source of truth. Run `python tools/build_generators.py` after editing.
Odds come from V2.0 (1.12): each regrowth rolls 1 of 81 equally likely outcomes (two 9-slot dispensers).
type roll: cobblestone 4/9 -> 'common', log 2/9 -> 'mid', apple 1/9 -> 'rare', lapis 2/9 -> ore roll
ore roll:  coal 3/9 -> 'ore1', iron 3/9 -> 'ore2', gold 2/9 -> 'ore3', diamond 1/9 -> 'ore4'
so per 81: common 36, mid 18, rare 9, ore1 6, ore2 6, ore3 4, ore4 2.
FIELD generators (one per team, feedback #39) work like V2: the outcome is a BLOCK that grows on top of the sea lantern
and is mined by hand. Coins come only from mining it (purse yields, nx.coinval), items are the block's normal drops.
tables.<team>.<lvl>: [drop item, weight, block?] - the block that grows (default: the drop item itself);
['coins', weight, emeralds, block] = an emerald ore / block outcome (pays through the purse when mined);
['jackpot:<id>', weight] = a chest filled with jackpots.<id>.
levels.<n>.regrow_ticks = delay before a mined block grows back (sped up by team size: x(1 + (players-1)/players_per_roll)).
single = optional single-block mode (feedback #47): one block type that rolls the same odds as a loot table when mined.
CENTRE generator (shared, in the arena, pot style): see centre._doc.
_levels_doc: upgrade_cost = coins to reach this level (V2 signs: 75 built Lv1, 200 -> Lv2, 500 -> Lv3).

_doc: Single-block variant (feedback #47), a config switch next to the multi-block V2 generator.
on = default mode (false = V2 blocks). Runtime switch: function nonios:generator/mode/toggle (#single nx.gen).
Every regrowth is the same block (mined with a pickaxe, no tool swapping). Mined, it rolls the same V2 table
(tables.<team>.<lvl>, same 1-of-81 odds) as a loot table: generator/one/<team>_lvl<N> (type fishing, so Fortune
on the pickaxe applies to ore drops). Outcomes whose V2 block is in src/yields.json also pay that block's yield
through the purse, exactly as if it had been mined (emerald ore 5, emerald block 20, coal 0.1, ...). No traps.
block: any block nobody else uses; its own vanilla loot table is emptied.

chest_a._from: V2 lvl2 chest (both teams); its emerald block is not modelled

_doc: Shared generator in the middle of the arena (feedback #39/#40, #127, #130): a fountain that keeps spitting emeralds
(the coin item: picked-up emeralds go straight into the purse) onto the floor around it. Emeralds only, never other items.
Every interval_ticks it throws 1 + B / bank_per_roll emeralds (max max_rolls), B = coins in BOTH team banks;
x golden_mult (arena config) during Golden Hour. No throw while item_cap emeralds lie within 4 blocks.
levels.<n>: reached at bank B >= bank; core_scale = size of the spinning emerald core (the level you can see).
Runs only while the arena runs (battle).
